title: Kubernetes is an execution environment, not a strategy

questions.question: What can a Pod restart expose in an application design?
options: That retries may repeat an external effect
questions.explanation: Restarted or retried work makes idempotency and durable state essential.

questions.question: What should a readiness check normally answer?
options: Whether every external provider is perfect
Whether this instance should receive traffic
Whether a user likes the response
Whether a Job completed last week
questions.explanation: Readiness is about safely receiving traffic, not broad dependency perfection.
